events.description: High volume of 50 failed login attempts from a single IP address indicating a potential brute-force or credential stuffing attack.
events.action: Block IP address 192.168.1.100, enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA), and audit targeted user accounts.

events.description: An internal host (10.0.0.55) downloaded an unusually large volume of data (15.5 GB), which may indicate an insider threat or compromised credentials.
events.action: Isolate the host 10.0.0.55, terminate active user sessions, and review audit logs to identify compromised cloud resources.

events.description: An internal host (172.16.0.200) performed a large-scale port scan across 1000 ports, indicating a potential compromised asset undergoing lateral movement discovery.
events.action: Isolate the host 172.16.0.200 from the network, inspect running processes, and review firewall/VPC traffic logs.
